g.text: Held by one engine (purpose:start:pid recorded in gpu.lock)
cmd: uv run pytest tests/inference/test_gpu_lease.py -q | pass: test_lock_file_is_not_unlinked_on_release and test_context_manager_releases pass (acquire returns True, holder() names the purpose)

cmd: uv run pytest tests/inference/test_gpu_lease.py -q | pass: test_second_exclusive_engine_with_a_different_purpose_is_refused and test_a_second_process_is_refused_while_this_one_holds_the_lease pass (acquire returns False, other process exits 3)
cmd: uv run pytest tests/inference/test_gpu_lease.py -q | pass: test_lease_is_free_again_after_release passes
cmd: just gpu-run llm-chat sleep 30 | pass: stderr prints 'gpu-run: lease acquired for llm-chat'; the command runs in the foreground
cmd: just gpu-run image-gen true | pass: exit status 75 and stderr 'gpu-run: refused: the GPU lease is held by [llm-chat:...]; nothing was started'
cmd: just up-leased qwen | pass: stderr prints 'gpu-run: lease acquired for vllm-qwen' and the pod runs in the foreground (podman kube play --wait)
cmd: just up-leased granite | pass: exit status 75 and stderr 'gpu-run: refused: the GPU lease is held by [vllm-qwen:...]; nothing was started'
cmd: Ctrl-C or SIGTERM to the holder | pass: the pod is removed (podman pod ps lists no wattson pod) and stderr prints 'gpu-run: lease released for vllm-qwen'
